notes: Engram memory is automatically synchronized: mem_context at session start, mem_session_summary after each OPSX phase (propose/apply/archive). All architectural decisions, discoveries, and learnings are persisted across sessions and team members.

hooks.command: engram sync --project active-trace-nla; git add .engram/; git diff --cached --quiet .engram/; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { git commit -m 'chore(engram): sync team memories'; git push origin master }
